regions.purpose: Top of the sheet — a small, secondary breadcrumb identifying the owning Collection. A 10dp appearance-color dot followed by the Collection name in a label-weight type set in onSurfaceVariant; reads as contextual chrome, not as content of equal weight to the subject below. The whole row is a tap target that opens the Collection.

Middle of the sheet — the subject. The Location's display name is rendered in a display-weight type (Material 3 headlineMedium) with generous vertical padding so it visually dominates the sheet. The whole region is a tap target that opens the LocationSheet peek of every Collection Entry that references this Location, plus the add-another-Entry-at-this-Location affordance.

Bottom of the sheet — a tertiary affordance reflecting the Review. Two stacked lines on the left: first line is the status — 'Unreviewed' when the Entry has no Review instance, or 'Reviewed {date}' using the Review instance's created date when it does; second line is the Review's summary field (Review.template.summaryField, doc01.03 §3) rendered to a single line — a score in its configured style (stars, number, icon), text truncated to a first line, an enum's picked option, a power-ranking's position; the second line is omitted when the template declares no summary field or the Entry is unreviewed. On the right, a trailing outlined edit (pencil) icon in onSurfaceVariant signifies that pressing the row opens the Review form for editing; the whole row is the tap target, not just the icon.

affordances.label: Edit the Review
affordances.rendering: Whole-row tap target with a trailing outlined edit (pencil) icon in onSurfaceVariant as the affordance signifier.

affordances.label: Dismiss
affordances.note: Bottom-sheet swipe-down or scrim-tap gesture on the sheet shell itself, not a tap on any of the three content regions.
